title: Adjacent page number in the viewed branding region falsely rejects an otherwise exact quote
review_basis: Retained native155 reviewer rejected the full correct manufacturer/footer quote because source box also contained page100. Adding100 only to visible_quote was then correctly rejected as differing from its actual block. Exact arguments and responses retained, without raw transcript.
failure_oracle: Corroborate the complete unchanged quote within a viewed native region with adjacent text allowed. Never accept word fragments, translation, missing words or changed numbers/operators as matching.
